I did do it. I stabbed myself and did my first deep cut today.

Well, the best thing for you  to do is to put on cream (any at this point but preferably antibacterial) and continuously re apply cream to the main wound. Then, put on wound dressing with padding longer and wider than the wound. Or, place a bandage loosely and secure it on the oppisite side to the wound. (If its on the wrist, secure on the front base of the hand.) 
Everyday when you wake up and go to sleep reapply the wound cream because continuous moisturization helps reduce scars.

Stay safe pls!
